contract_inferred: No 00-contract.md. Inferred from the page: web, Persuade with Read (the home page of a design skill for agents, with a before-and-after hero, a testimonial marquee, a labelled gallery of AI-slop tells, a command console, a live demo, a 'design directions' card deck and documentation-style sections). The slop gallery, the before panels and the demo hotel page are exhibits shown on purpose; they are judged as exhibits, and the page's own layout is judged here. English only (html lang en at every width), no market named. No right-to-left language.
overall_reason: The layout is built for real content (20 breakpoints, 112 min-width: 0 rules, wrapping labels, no overflow at any width), but a quarter of the text needs script and the observer to appear, and the design-direction cards load 2,048px images into 300px slots.

score.reason: T-WIDTHS, T-HOSTILE-CONTENT and T-TRUNCATION pass, but T-WEIGHT-FOR-JOB fails the largest-image budget on the card deck (ROB-018) and T-NO-SCRIPT loses 25% of the text (ROB-015, citing the sweep's ROB-001 Floors).

findings.title: Weight fits the page's job
findings.where: 'Give your design a different starting point.' card deck, div.worlds-hand-zone > ul.worlds-hand > li.worlds-card > div.worlds-card-media > img, 1440px
findings.evidence: highlife-sleeve-hero.webp (704 KiB) and digital-design-canon-greiman-hybrid-collage-hero.webp (692 KiB) are 2,048px wide and shown at about 302px (6.8 times oversize); ten oversized images total 2,341 KiB of the page's 2,373 KiB of images (performance.images.oversized_over_2.2x). The largest-image budget fails (700 KiB) and the transfer and image budgets warn.
findings.before: The card deck shows each design direction's full hero image as a card thumbnail.
findings.after: Serve 320px and 640px WebP thumbnails through srcset for the cards and load the 2,048px hero only on the direction's own page (draft ROB-167).
findings.why: Two cards in a deck cost 1.4 MB, more than the rest of the page's code, styles and fonts together, on a page a phone visitor scrolls through once.
findings.root: Card thumbnails taken from the full hero renditions

findings.title: Content and navigation do not depend on script
findings.where: Whole page, scripts off and observer never fires, all widths
findings.evidence: With scripts off 5,397 of 7,492 characters are visible (share 0.72) and the scripts-off page has 221 fewer characters in total; with an observer that never fires 5,421 are visible (share 0.724) (resilience.hidden_content). The sweep's hidden_content detector records both as ROB-001 Floors (1,765 and 1,741 characters).
findings.before: About a quarter of the text is revealed by script or by an IntersectionObserver.
findings.after: Render the revealed sections visible in the HTML and arm the reveal only from script, with a timeout that shows everything (draft ROB-204); keep script for the console, the demo and the card deck.
findings.why: A reader without script, or whose observer does not fire, loses a quarter of the documentation-style sections.

strengths: The document width equals the viewport at every width, and 20 breakpoints with 112 min-width: 0 rules let the hero, the slop gallery, the console and the documentation sections restack cleanly at 375 (tiles/375-00.png to tiles/375-11.png).

The console's intent buttons wrap at a phrase inside fixed tiles at 375 ('Make text easier to read' on three lines, tiles/375-05.png) instead of clipping, and file paths in the terminal panel stay inside their box (long_unbroken_strings).
75 of 81 images are lazy-loaded, 14 aspect-ratio rules reserve their space, and the lab LCP is 616 ms.
The testimonial marquee clamps long quotes inside fixed cards and runs in its own clipped track, so no quote pushes the layout.
The exhibit regions (the labelled slop tells, the before panels, the 'Welcome to Our Hotel' demo) are judged as exhibits; their deliberate faults are not counted against the page.
not_investigated: T-STRESS: no hostile content was injected; long names were judged from layout evidence.
A right-to-left render and translated strings were not captured. The page uses physical properties almost only (263 physical against 23 logical); a readiness note for an English-only page.
The page load was not throttled and layout shift was not measured as a number (capture predates the CLS record). The one readable @font-face has font-display not set.
T-FAILURE-PATH and T-SLOW-LINE: the async runs on 'Book Now' and 'generate' navigated the page and are not verified.
T-EXTREME-COUNTS: '62 checks' and '184k' stars are fixed copy; the card deck's 'Showing 6 design directions' count was not exercised.
One stylesheet was cross-origin and unreadable; its rules are unknown, not absent. 25 requests were blocked by the capture.
Widths between the captures, landscape, zoom at 200%, back navigation and deep links.
